description: Validates and transforms a project-spec into the ORDERED SEQUENCE of offline operations (subnets→devices→modules→network→tags→blocks→compile), WITHOUT touching serve. Gated operations (connect/download) are NOT included. Returns { steps, assumptions, plc } or the violations if invalid. PLC-scoped steps (tag tables, tags, FBs, instance DBs, compile) carry the {plc} placeholder: tia_spec_apply resolves the PlcSoftware TIA created for the device (named after the CPU device item, e.g. PLC_1 — not after the device; set the optional plcName on the device to choose it) right after the device step.
name: tia_spec_plan
title: TIA — plan project-spec (without applying)
